sources.title: neo4j-labs/text2cypher | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document provides an introduction to the text2cypher repository, which contains resources for training Large Language Models (LLMs) to translate natural language questions into Cypher queries for Neo4j graph databases. This page covers the repository's purpose, core capabilities, and high-level architecture.
